_annotation_1: 1. INITIALIZE EXCHANGE. The host connects to the MCP server and negotiates protocol versions. The LLM is NOT involved here.
_annotation_2: 2. TOOLS/LIST EXCHANGE. The host asks the server what tools it has so it can expose them to the LLM. The LLM is NOT involved here.

_annotation_3: 3. MODEL CALL: After tool discovery, the host sends the user prompt + tool schemas to Gemini. The model decides to call get_claim.
_annotation_4: 4. TOOLS/CALL EXCHANGE. Host executes the model's requested tool call against the MCP server. The LLM is NOT involved here; it just waits for the result.
